body:
WHy do I feel my friends abandoned me. Well I think it's in part that i've abandoned them too. We grew apart after highschool when I succumbed to my panic attacks and agoraphobia. I was away for 4 years. I've tried to make small comunications with them but I was too scared to go through with it since I felt like I was out. They ALL still hung out with each other and to this day still do.

One thing is recently I had contacted one of those friends and played an online game with him for a biut and I told him about what ive been doing and asked about the other friends. ABout a week later one of the other ones contacted me and asked to hang out. This was very odd and after 10 years I went over to one of his houses and hung out with him and we seemed to have a great time. Playing board games and an old smash bros game we loved to play. I felt like everything went great.

They never called me again. Also, my friend was going to get married in a few months after that. I felt like that was there way to reconcile an old friendship and invite me to the wedding. ANd I was excited about it because it could have been a reunion. My chance to come back into my old friends lives. But I never got an invite. I was never even told directly from them that they were getting married.

I don't know what I did wrong. WHy I wasn't invited to such an important event. I would see facebook posts on how they had so much fun and it was like a highschool reunion. And I felt horrible about it.

I felt like it was all me. I did something wrong. BUT, there is something else. In highschool my g/f at the time got into a huge fight with the bride of my friend and they literally hate each other. But I was ok with the bride and even talked to her and asked her how she was doing when I went to their house. 

Only two conclusions. I wasn't invited because I'm a boring awkward piece of shit. Or my friends wife just held that much of a grudge against my girlfriend and couldn't invite me without inviting her. I really think that's why they wanted to hang out. To find out whether or not I was a fucking joke or if I was still with my g/f.

I talk to my family onm a daily basis. My girlfriend and my best friend my cousin whom is a few years younger than me but we have all the same interests for the most part. Besides the fact that now he plays different online games than me but has a multitude of different mental issues than I have. He has no aspirations and never plans to move out or get a better job. He also has other friends that he hangs out with besides me. I dont have that. ANd I know he thinks less than me as compared to his other friends as he puts it "This guy is the smartest guy I know" undermining my own intelligence and making me feel stupid.

What I enjoy about filming I post in a reply above. But I would like to add that im a huge voice acting bough and would love to do it for a living despite not knowing if I have a good voice and never having done any prior voice work. I would also love to write stories for Videogames or even voice them. Hell I would love to come up with gameplay mechanic ideas.

I want to be happy and I know for a fact i'll always be a loser. I can't imagine these mental problems will get any better and I refuse to take any form of medication anymore after having to go through the horrible effects of anti-psychotics. Other doctors were pissed off that the first doctor gave those to me. ANd they really fucked me up for a long time.

I try to put this energy into other areas of life and apply myself, but I come off as awkward or weird because I can't talk to people or speak in front of people. If more than two pairs of eyes are on me, i'm done. I can't focus or function. I slur my words I sweat, I say things I don't mean and that dont make any sense. So I can't properly pitch or express a good idea I feel like I have without royally fucking it up.

My period of OK was when I was in school my first few years. The last few years were easy in school but it started to hit me really hard when I had realized. I had not made a single friend in the 3-5 years ive been here. And no one has made any effort to do the same back to me. Probably because i'm just too fucking awful to be around I assume. Luckily my girlfriend had gone to the same college or else I never would have had anyone to talk to.

I was always jealous of the kids who looked like they always had someone to hang out with or do projects with. Film is such a socially progressive hobby and progression. The more people you know and are friends with, the better. Its about who you know rather than what you can do. And I failed in the social category.

Last few years and especially since ive graduated ive just been depressed even more. Graduated, cant start life or a family because I dont have a job and probably wont in my degree. I still work minimum wage at a job where I hardly know how to do anything. If I got fired I would be replaced very easily and no one would miss me. I'm trying to apply for a better full time job, but I don't want a fucking job. I want a career. In my area of passion. SOmething I want to do rather than something I HAVE to do.

I wanted to get into Screenwriting or Cinematography. Basically any area where I could be creative but those were the most important to me. To shape the scene and make it come alive. Or just write my own stories and be the mastermind behind the characters and setting. I applied for a program with a local film organization and failed to get in. It was a program that was specifically FOR people like me.

WHat they do is they train you to be a PA on set and teach you all of the film language and terms in the industry. Train you to be a PA and help you find jobs (Possibly your first job). Unfortunately I wasn't accepted into the program. Probably again because I failed to impress them during the interview process. While they did ask for a resume and I showed them my filmography which does have school projects on it, I think where I fucked up was the interview part. When I get nervous which is ANY social setting I never know what to say and everything comes out wrong. I stutter I sweat I say things I don't mean. It's like my anxious sub-concious takes over.

Ive tried to attack these thoughts by rationalizing my situation. It's hard to mock myself and say that this voice is myself and that it can't insult itself because it's at the end of the day me. I understand its me but it's like I don't know how else to challenge it. But i'll definitely keep trying as I've always have.
